name: Saady Chohan
headline: IT turned Quantity Surveyor | PlanSwift Trainer | Construction #1 Creator in Ireland | Top QS Voice by Linkedin | 100 Built Influencers by LMC | Noble QS Founder | 25K+ YouTube Community

posts.text: Still trying to process what’s happening. I honestly didn’t expect my resignation post to get this much attention. Seeing thousands of new people connect with me in just 24 hours feels unreal. Thank you so much for all the love and support. More updates coming soon. 🙏❤️

Its time to say goodbye after 3 memorable years at AECOM. 

It has been a privilege to work with the Dublin Cost Management team. I am grateful for the experience, opportunities, valuable connections and many good memories from this chapter of my career.

Thank you AECOM for everything. Wishing everyone continued success.
Last site walk on this project after being part of it for the past year. One day, I ll probably drive past and proudly tell my friends, “I worked on this project.” - Time for the next challenge. 🏗️

The software and tools I use daily as a Quantity Surveyor in Dublin:

CostX - PlanSwift - Bluebeam Revu - Revit - AutoCAD - Navisworks - HoloBuilder - DroneDeploy - Microsoft Excel - Power BI - SharePoint - Procore - Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) - BIM 360 - Microsoft Teams - OneNote - Microsoft Copilot - ChatGPT - Adobe Acrobat Pro - Google Earth Pro - Canva - Cubit - Buildsoft.

My parents used to say, “Study hard, or you will end up working in construction.” Well… after earning two masters degrees, I still ended up working in construction. 😅

Turns out, they forgot to mention that construction can be a great career. :)
